name: single-kana
provenance: Authored by hand by the Test Developer (claude-opus-5) for MT-007 RED on 2026-09-15. Wholly synthetic.
purpose: AC-2 and C-6. This is the fixture that pins MIN_REGION_AREA_PX: a single-kana bubble of 252 px that MUST survive, and a 4 px speckle INSIDE an accepted box that must not. The speckle is inside a box on purpose - a speckle outside the fence is discarded by the box intersection and would test nothing about the floor.

paint.note: 14x18 = 252 px: one kana in a small bubble

boxes.note: an accepted box that happens to contain nothing but speckle

notes: The pair brackets the constant: 4 < MIN_REGION_AREA_PX <= 252. Upstream's 20 sits inside that bracket, and so does C-6's measured p10 of 44.

It also discriminates WHERE the floor is applied. Dilated by 2 iterations of a 7x7 kernel the 4 px speckle becomes 14x14 = 196 px and, fenced by its 30x30 box, survives any floor below 196 - so a floor applied AFTER dilation emits a region for 4 px of noise, which is what AC-2 forbids. See the story's amendment A-7.
